Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the magnetic properties of the materials involved. It falsely claimed that aluminum is paramagnetic and weakly attracted by horseshoe magnets, whereas aluminum is actually diamagnetic (weakly repelled) and is not attracted to magnets. Conversely, it incorrectly suggested that many common steel screws (which are typically ferromagnetic) might be non-magnetic (referring to austenitic stainless steel), ignoring that standard steel screws used in general contexts are ferromagnetic. This fundamental error in physics led the Planner to reject the most effective solution (the magnet) and choose an ineffective one (a screen filter), which cannot separate screws of the same size/material composition based on their properties.
